market.question: Who will finish higher: Russell or Antonelli?

assessment.reasoning: Miami GP race May 3 2026: Antonelli on pole, Russell P5 on grid. Antonelli leads championship 75-68 after Sprint and has been faster on pace this weekend (~0.4s in qualifying).
